text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Multiple Private VPC customers reporting 502/connection errors to our ILB-backed endpoints in eu-west1 and us-central1. Potential cross-region routing suppression. Paging oncall (eli). Please acknowledge and triage.
eli (oncall): acked, I'm on it. seeing increased 502 rates on the EU ILB frontends in the dashboard.
maya (sre): also seeing spike in backend 5xx in logs for private-vpc tenants, but host-level health shows services healthy. suspect networking/ILB.
carlos (networks): on preliminary check GCP ILB controlplane shows higher error rates for route program/propagation. I'm pulling GCP console, opening gcloud traces.
sarah (support): several customers have opened support cases — major impact: app endpoints unreachable, retries fail. customers affected: fintech-ops, analytics-pro, several private VPCs in EU. I'll start templating notifications.
tom (eng-infra): our global router metrics show sudden drop in cross-region forwarding success for ILB IPs. local regional paths OK. looks like cross-region route propagation suppressed for a subset of ILB VIPs.
eli (oncall): can we confirm if this correlates with any recent config rollouts? didn't see infra deploys in last hour.
maya (sre): no infra deploys. also our observability (monitoring-bot / third-party) shows delayed metrics ingestion around the same time — metric gaps for 10m — might be correlated. I'll open a monitoring vendor ticket.
monitoring-bot: Alert: Datadog ingestion latency spike at 1840123000-1840123600, >5m delay for metrics/trace ingestion. Ticket: DD-98712 created.
carlos (networks): running commands to verify ILB healthchecks from multiple regions:
```
# from us-central1 bastion
curl -svI --connect-timeout 2 http://10.240.5.13/health
# from eu-west1 bastion
curl -svI --connect-timeout 2 http://10.240.5.13/health
```
Response: eu-west1 probes time out intermittently, us-central ok.
eli (oncall): interesting — controlplane could be suppressing some ILB route fanout to remote regions. any GCP control plane notices?
gcp-se-bot: GCP Status: No public incident for ILB product. Private ticket opened: GCP-TKT-554321 referencing control-plane route-programmer errors in internal logs. SE assigned (contact: gcp-se).
maya (sre): I'm seeing errors in router-agent logs: "route_update_failed: ECONNRESET to controlplane" — snippet:
```
2024-11-15T09:12:03Z router-agent[pid]: route_update_failed route=projects/.../forwardingRules/ilb-xyz err=ECONNRESET
2024-11-15T09:12:04Z router-agent[pid]: retrying in 2s
```
sarah (support): copy. prepping customer note: short explanation + workaround (regional endpoint pinning) + ETA to follow.
jenn (customer-success): please tag affected accounts; I'll coordinate CS outreach after first mitigation. prioritize fintech-ops.
carlos (networks): mitigation idea: force regional failover by creating a temporary regional ILB in eu-west1 and update private VPC route advertisement to prefer eu-local path (minimize cross-region dependencies). this requires config change and brief routing churn (~30s). thoughts?
tom (eng-infra): agreed — we can spin up regional ILB and update policy via terraform apply with canary ramp. I'll prepare a script.
eli (oncall): do it. runbook step: create regional ILB, attach backend sets, update route-advertise priority to prefer regional, monitor. we should also enable a fallback route to Dedicated (if customers have dedicated capacity) to reduce impact.
maya (sre): implementing emergency regional ILB creation now. pushing to staging then to prod tenanted VPCs.
monitoring-bot: Note: due to Datadog ingestion delays some of our dashboards may show stale data for 5-10m — use direct logs/traces for immediate verification.
eli (oncall): manual checks after regional ILB up:
- internal curl to VIP from eu bastion -> 200 OK
- synthetic health checks showing success
- customer errors drop from 75%->10% after traffic shift
maya (sre): confirmed: regional ILB live; traffic shift in progress; error rate trending down.
jenn (customer-success): notifying fintech-ops / analytics-pro that we have a regional mitigation in place and are monitoring; offering scheduled follow-up.
carlos (networks): GCP SE responded: controlplane node experiencing high connection churn to our routers; they recommend increasing controlplane retry/backoff and they are investigating internal scheduler. filing for higher priority.
el i (oncall): typo — eli (oncall) here. updating incident timeline for postmortem: root cause suspected: GCP controlplane route-programmer instability combined with third-party observability ingestion delay which slowed detection and remediation automation.
maya (sre): plan for next steps: 1) continue traffic shift for impacted tenants 2) keep regional ILB until GCP confirms controlplane stability 3) implement automated fallback to regional local path in our routing policies 4) follow up with monitoring vendor about ingestion SLA/alerting gaps 5) runbook update for similar controlplane suppression events.
sarah (support): customers informed. will escalate if any reopen.
eli (oncall): handing off to night oncall (tom) for watch. I'm going to create a concise incident handoff note below. please react :thumbsup: if you got it.
eli (oncall): HANDOFF NOTE - Incident 1840123999
- Start: 1840123999
- Symptom: ILB-backed Private VPC endpoints failing for cross-region requests (eu->us, etc.), 502/connection errors
- Impact: multiple private VPC customers, highest-severity for fintech-ops
- Mitigation: emergency regional ILB created in eu-west1; traffic reweighted to regional path; error rate reduced to ~10%
- Current status: mitigation in place; GCP investigating controlplane; monitoring ingestion delayed, using logs for verification
- Actions for next oncall: keep traffic shifted, monitor GCP SE updates, prepare rollback if instability persists, update customers on major changes
- Links: internal runbook /runbooks/ilb-controlplane, gcp ticket GCP-TKT-554321, datadog ticket DD-98712

tom (eng-infra): taking watch. will keep watch until GCP confirms. copied runbook, thanks all. :white_check_mark:
